title: A pattern never matches null

blocks.text: `null instanceof String s` is `false`, so a pattern is null-safe and never throws. When `null` needs an answer of its own, test for it separately, before the pattern.

items: a String: `"text of "` and its length, so `describe("hello")` is `"text of 5"`;
anything else: `"not text"`, so `describe(42)` is `"not text"`.

cases.says: "hello" is text of 5 and 42 is not text.

concepts: A pattern never matches null, so null that needs its own answer is tested separately.
